source.quote_free_summary: Members pay the WSDC a Competitor Surcharge of $2 per competitor entry per Jack and Jill contest, due within 30 days after the Registry Event closes.

requirement: A future WSDC profile must track the surcharge as an organizer obligation, not a competitor charge.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED.  DanceFlow does not verify or fulfill it; it remains the organizer's responsibility (R-14) unless DanceFlow explicitly implements and verifies it in a future body profile. It must not block eligible Studio/Custom competitions.
interpretation_notes: WSDC: effective_from 2026-01-17 is taken from the file name (Updated Jan17 2026); the footers read Version 2026.1C and the file name says 2026.1B (registry note). Re-read 2026-11-24. The obligation is the member's (organizer's) to the WSDC. DanceFlow must NOT automatically collect or charge it to competitors and does not remit it. FINDING: the advanced page WSDC profile form creates an active flat per-entry fee rule 'WSDC competitor surcharge' when the organizer enters an amount (actions.ts, event_competition_fee_rules), which the registration quote charges to competitors; that is organizer-configured, not automatic, but it is a behavior to review separately. BLOCKER for a WSDC profile.
